content.short: Cropty Wallet is a custodial crypto wallet for storing, sending, buying, selling, and earning with TON and other assets.
content.description: Cropty Wallet is a consumer crypto wallet focused on simple custody, fast transfers, and everyday asset management. Its site highlights support for hundreds of tokens, buying and selling crypto, earning, borrowing, donations, and multi-chain use in one interface. For TON users, it fits as a wallet and payments app rather than a trading venue. The app presents موثوق من قبل أكثر من 1 مليون مستخدم, الأجهزة المتوافقة, ملاذك الآمن للعملات المشفرة, and أمن بمستوى الحصن في جيبك as core parts of the workflow.
